title: MT41036: Stochastic Modelling Of Materials
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite - NilProbability and Distributions, Introduction to Stochastic
Processes, Markov Chains, Markov Processes with Discrete and Continuous State
Space, Renewal Processes and Theory, Stochastic Models for diffusion, defects
and their transport, evolution of mesoscopic structures like grains and cracks,
transport properties of materials.Text Books:1.J. Medhi : Stochastic Processes,
New Age International Limited, New Delhi, 2nd Ed., 2004.2.S. Yip (Ed.):
Handbook of Materials Modeling, Springer, 2005.
